howToPlay: Tara is a Mythic damage dealer who excels at grouping enemies together with her Super. Use her cards to deal piercing damage and utilize her gadgets to scout hidden enemies or summon extra support. Time her Super carefully to pull opponents into a cluster for massive damage.
gears: Equip DAMAGE for increased effectiveness when health is low and PET POWER to boost the strength of her shadow summons. Use SPEED or VISION to better navigate the map and track hidden opponents.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical positioning and landing high-impact area-of-effect abilities.
